extracted.name: Dorothy Lynch Style Salad Dressing
extracted.description: Mix up a batch of this tangy tomato dressing for your taco salads.
instruction_lines: Mix tomato soup, vegetable oil, sugar, vinegar, dry mustard, salt, celery seeds, black pepper, and garlic powder in a large jar with a lid. For thicker dressing, stir in cornstarch. Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight for best flavor.
